claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: RX-821002 is a high-affinity alpha2-adrenoceptor antagonist with no intrinsic cytotoxic activity; at 2.5 uM it is expected to be largely inactive in a 5-day pooled viability screen, with any weak, non-selective antiproliferative effect attributable to off-target cationic amphiphilic/lysosomotropic stress rather than adrenergic receptor blockade.
